$comment: Inputs for pipeline:basin. outletSearchBbox is a search window, not a coordinate: the step picks the sea-draining reach with the largest upstream area inside it and reports it for review; the Río Colorado mouth (~39.8°S) is outside it on purpose. reference is only a sanity check: the project's basin area is the computed polygon area, and AIC's figure is a rounded number from a descriptive page.

reference.source: AIC, 'La Cuenca', https://www.aic.gob.ar/sitio/lacuenca (read 2026-09-30): 'Drena una superficie de 140.000 Km2' (Limay, Neuquén and Negro)
